title: RBC Bearings Announces Participation in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about RBC Bearings Inc's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
OXFORD, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 9, 2026-- RBC Bearings Incorporated (NYSE: “RBC”), a leading international manufacturer of highly engineered precision bearings, components and essential systems for the industrial, aerospace and defense industries, today announced management will participate in three upcoming investor conferences, including:


- Deutsche Bank 16th Annual Aviation Forum on September 10, 2026, in New York, NY
- Alembic Global Advisors 4th Annual Torrey Pines Conference on September 14, 2026, in La Jolla, CA
- Morgan Stanley 14th Annual Laguna Conference on September 16, 2026, in Dana Point, CA


RBC’s latest investor presentation is available online at:[https://investor.rbcbearings.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.rbcbearings.com&esheet=54601407&newsitemid=20260909843160&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.rbcbearings.com&index=1&md5=02cd04395131c690feb9b603d0c0c0e5) .


**About RBC Bearings**


RBC Bearings Incorporated is an international manufacturer and marketer of highly engineered precision bearings, components and essential systems. Founded in 1919, the Company is primarily focused on producing highly technical or regulated bearing products and components requiring sophisticated design, testing, and manufacturing capabilities for the diversified industrial, aerospace and defense markets. The Company is headquartered in Oxford, Connecticut.
